_note: Деталь 2 — Zone 2 PEEK thermal-break sleeve (01_01 §1 + §4.1/§4.2). Frozen: bore Ø11 (= Zone-1 shaft, press-fit H7/s6), wall 2.0 mm (robust default — NOT CTE-limited: unified Lamé §4.2 gives combined SF 5.6× / thermal-only 14.6× / press-fit-only 9×, so no mode is load-bearing), OD Ø15 = wound in tree (CODIT <25 → DBH ≥38), length 50 mm (axial thermal break, §4.1). Plain round bore: hex anti-rotation (§4.3 C, ≤0.05 mm) is bench-gated → deferred (00_07). DIN-471 retaining grooves are on the Ti Zone-1/Zone-3 ends (§3 step 6), not the PEEK sleeve; bore stays smooth (barbs press in at 150 °C, §3 steps 4-5).
name: zone2_sleeve

notes.process: CNC from rod; anneal 200-250 C before final micromachining (else internal stress drifts the um tolerances)
notes.post_process: None after final micromachining. The one thermal step is the 200-250 C anneal, and it belongs BEFORE that cut, not after - see process and inspection: reversing the order is the failure, not omitting a step
notes.surface_finish: smooth round bore (hex anti-rotation 4.3 C, <=0.05 mm, is bench-gated -> deferred)
notes.coating_restriction: Nothing is applied to this part - 01_02 3.6 excludes ZnO-Ta, self-healing 8-HQ and biomimetic layers from PEEK surfaces outright, and the Zone-2 row of that map is not blank - it carries three explicit refusals. The bore is a press-fit surface specified in micrometres (01_01 4.2), so a coating of thickness t would also eat 2t of the interference band
notes.inspection: Bore diameter and concentricity to the tolerance block on this manifest (bore axis is the primary datum). Verify the 200-250 C anneal was done BEFORE final micromachining - the order is the requirement, because internal stress released afterwards drifts exactly the micrometre-level fit this part exists to hold. OD is the WOUND diameter in the tree (01_01 1: wound 15 < 25 mm keeps CODIT tolerable, hence DBH >= 38 cm), i.e. a tree-facing dimension, not a cosmetic one: growing it raises the DBH threshold at which a tree may be instrumented
extra: Press-fit Lame-computed (HW.3.IS script 50, frozen O11/2mm, E_PEEK 4.0 GPa): contact P_c 0.49-3.32 MPa -> 0.32-2.16 at 20yr; at MIN H7/s6 fit the relaxed P_c <= sap -> the O-ring is the essential seal (PEEK backup marginal)
OD O15 = wound in tree (CODIT <25 -> DBH >=38); wall 2.0 = robust default, NOT CTE-limited (unified Lame 4.2: combined SF 5.6x, thermal-only 14.6x)
Mechanical retention (barbs + DIN-471) is on the Ti ends, not this PEEK bore (4.3)
